authority.scope: User-approved local W09 recovery including duplicate prevention and erasure safeguards; exact ten source/fixture/kit files plus this record. No deployment or new cloud resources.

implemented: Exact LEDGER_RECOVERY_ENABLED==='true' gates producer managed identities and fallback; consumers/eraser recognize managed data independently. Legacy/default-off producer behavior and existing logical IDs remain.

Frozen delivery UUID plus full-delivery digest/count commitment rejects reuse across changed payload/carrier/partition. Immutable part claims bind UUID, tenant/hour/stream, digest/count and canonical range-key destination. Metadata resides under fixed non-date ledger-delivery/identities and ledger-delivery/claims namespaces, outside canonical tenant/date listings.

Canonical NDJSON retains original fields plus reserved _ledger_delivery {id,ordinal}. The common sink conditionally creates/appends by original destination across regrouped/partial/uncertain retries, deduplicates transport identity rather than logical IDs, and rejects conflicting provenance.

New claims retain grouped canonical objects with 100-part/16MiB bounds. Part bytes are cached, and each CAS attempt reloads the object before fresh journal/tombstone checks. Existing rows are append-only in the sink; incoming cutoff rows are suppressed. At most three retries after explicit null preconditions; thrown storage errors are terminal.

Producer queue rejection, missing capability and oversized queue rows can use the same frozen-identity sink. Queue receipt and R2 capture counts remain separate, with conserved newlyStored/alreadyPresent/suppressed/unknown/notAttempted disposition and one fixed-code/numeric failure diagnostic.

Managed erasure preserves marker/custom metadata and conditionally replaces bodies, including empty bodies instead of deleting managed data objects. Conflict or unexpected body retains durable intent and fails closed, without rebase or guessed credits. Exact after-state reconciles a lost acknowledgement.

Three added ledger groups and one added erasure group exercise actual shared producer/consumer/sink paths. Embedded Miniflare native R2 smoke verifies conditional create, stale ETag refusal, empty-body metadata retention and concurrent same-delivery capture; no emitted build or external service.

runtime.native_scope: Installed in-memory Miniflare R2 binding: actual conditional operations and shared sink calls through that binding, not a deployed full-worker/latency claim.

failures_and_superseding_validation.correction: Aligned synthetic target/cutoff/survivor/racer times within one original canonical hour/range. No production behavior changed. runtime-2 then passed all32.

failures_and_superseding_validation.result: No runtime failure; source review found acknowledgement/range validation asymmetries before freeze.

Added an out-of-range carrier refusal within the existing malformed-state group. Same fixed32 plus compiler/lint/whitespace passed on final bytes.

limitations: Bounded local managed capture only; independent frozen review/lead acceptance pending. Full W09/F16/N07/N08/N10, customer/contractual/release acceptance are not claimed.
Default-off; consumer-and-eraser-first rollout/activation is not performed or authorized by this record. Old consumers and unmarked legacy retry/partial-write behavior remain qualified residuals.
No durable raw outbox, DLQ/quarantine, process-kill-before-acknowledged-capture recovery, online fan-out reconciliation, SDK logical-event idempotency or automatic late-hour aggregate reconstruction.
Canonical grouping is preserved for healthy managed batches within explicit limits; exceptional fallback/regroup fragmentation and fold capacity are not a deployed throughput guarantee.

Fresh journal/tombstone reads and object CAS are not a global erasure transaction. Stale pre-journal/cutoff writes, body-ETag ABA, concurrent unconditional journal coordination and manifest omissions remain limitations. Unexpected body conflicts intentionally hold the durable intent; no automatic rebase/recovery coordinator is added.
Metadata-only commitments/claims and retained empty managed objects have no automatic purge/retention policy. D06 claim/key/retention lifecycle and D10 customer policy remain human decisions.

Serialization/AE scheduling begin synchronously; queue/R2 I/O remains in the existing unawaited background path. Queue acceptance, canonical capture and client delivery are distinct; no latency/SLO or complete durable recording claim.

Native evidence uses ephemeral synthetic Miniflare R2, with outbound access disabled. No external/customer-data/cloud-resource/credential operations, install/emitted build, deployment, commit/push or governance edits were performed.
